## What landed

**Stage 1 — CAPTURE (`crates/hh-runner/src/capture.rs`, `cell.rs`):**
- `CopyoutSpec`/`copyout_spec` — the ST4 `/logs/agent` copy-out leg:
  kernel-mediated `cp_out` after agent end and before verification
  (the `run_cell` ordering); `/work` aliasing refuses both directions
  (container source and host destination inside the work mount).
  `NativeLogBundle` hashes the copied tree into
  `trajectory.native_log`; `verify` recomputes every member + the
  manifest digest (AC-1).
- Post-hoc ATIF (REQ-XC-318): `AtifConverter` seam (production is the
  Harbor host venv at `ff2a1ef4`; `artifacts.atif.converter_at` pin
  check), `convert_atif` — absence (`"none"` or a converter failure)
  is a reported attribute (`trajectory.atif_absent`), never a gate;
  `publication_check_input` requires `proxy_transcript_ref` for every
  scored trial (C-16).
- `hh-integrity-bundle/1` — member digests + manifest recompute.
- `reconcile_receipts` (REQ-XC-207): native calls (main/subagent/
  background/title/compaction) must be receipted; unreceipted →
  `inconclusive{infra:unreceipted_call}`, precedence over a reward.
- `st4_verify` (REQ-XC-328) + `st4_plan`: post-agent version probe +
  install-tree re-hash vs the ST2 baseline → `harness_self_modified`,
  stays scored.

**Stage 2 — SMOKE-BATTERY (`crates/hh-runner/src/smoke.rs` + fixtures):**
- `hh-smoke/write-file` committed (`tests/fixtures/r6_25/task/`:
  instruction, `tests/test.sh`, `hh-smoke-task/1`; never a TB task).
- One scripted `hh.model_proxy.recording/1` (provenance `synthetic`)
  per harness in its own tool schema and streaming mode (mini
  non-streaming chat, pi streaming, claude `/v1/messages` SSE);
  `recording_shape` records-level member check (strict codec stays
  hh-hosting's — no K-2 edge); `hh-smoke-battery/1` plan:
  `keying: sequence`, `on_divergence: serve_recorded`, five variants.
- `check_smoke` — every §5.7 assertion per variant records-in over
  slot records: SM-pos (ST4 equal, receipts == script length, all on
  the model socket, mediator ⊆ expected_denied, no model-host
  CONNECTs, `exited{0}` + exit code, reward 1, leak_scan clean,
  Claude's R6.24 `sm_pos_assert` reused), SM-429 (429 + Retry-After →
  retry receipts or exit), SM-402 (`refused_budget` →
  `budget_refused` + verifies), SM-slow (buffered* modes, no
  client_gone below the bound), SM-hang (`agent_timeout` + group
  killed + verifies).
- `egress.probe` on `hh-harness-admission/1` (REQ-XC-311 — admission
  without a probe log refuses; `probe.observed` ⊆ expected_denied) +
  the AG5 rule (a granted non-model host fails the smoke).
- `model_socket_assert` (REQ-XC-312): receipts on the loopback relay +
  surface route; no relay-address request and no model-host
  tunnel/grant (denied vendor-host rows are the declared residuals).
- `endpoint_admission` (REQ-XC-203): Google-format-only or
  vendor-hosted → `n/a{endpoint}`; `receipt_on_surface` evidences the
  custom base URL.
- Completion (REQ-XC-321): exit code recorded, `agent_timeout` only
  with `deadline_enforced_ms`, `native_status` descriptive.
- `classify_hosting` — the §5.8 table over `HostingFacts`, one pure
  function incl. `inconclusive{infra:model_route:<d>}`; retry column
  (`engine_replan|no|new_admission|never_paid`), flags + covariates;
  `facts_from_records` recompute equals stored dispositions (AC-10).
- `scripts/check-hosting-offline.sh` (grep battery + `--self-test`)
  wired into ci.yml; both live legs `#[ignore = "live — ADR-0363: …"]`
  (W1/R6.32 owes the executed records — AG3/AG5/AG6/AG8 evidence).
